selection_rules: Primary papers, conference/workshop pages, author projects and official data/API docs
Remove arXiv/DOI/PDF duplicates of the same work
Include fixed pipelines and efficiency-focused systems, not only agent success stories
Separate claim verification, check-worthiness, QA factuality and generated-text evaluation
2026-10-23 is an observation cutoff; this is not a claim of complete literature coverage
excluded_or_deferred: Unofficial mirrors and SEO/blog summaries are not cited as paper evidence
Unverified generic 2026 abstention results were not included as confirmed findings
Other papers also named FactAgent were not conflated with Li et al. arXiv:2405.01593
No claim that a ready-to-use Korean open-web claim-evidence benchmark was exhaustively ruled out
Team member's existing paper list not yet received
Exact API quotas, complete data/code licences and runtime feasibility remain to be verified before use
conflicts_resolved: NumTemp is the earlier title of arXiv:2403.17169; use QuanTemp once
KoSimpleQA search summary and fetched abstract disagree on size; do not freeze a count
AVeriTeC 2024 Hungarian METEOR and 2025 Ev2R based scores must not be conflated
Korean RAG paper date checked as 2026, not inferred from its 2025 election subject
